A darker brown-gold outer border band about 14 px, NOT a black outline; inner face warm yellow #E7B23A, with inner corners cut diagonally like the gold line on the card back. Flat illustration, not a photographed or 3D card.

Small flat faceted gem-cut planes in 2–3 tones are allowed ONLY along the outer border band and the narrow empty perimeter outside the field positions. Keep the large top name strip, gap between panels and both panel interiors as absolutely uniform flat colors. Restrained sharp corner facet accents, broad clean geometry; no texture or shading inside plain surfaces. No text, letters, numbers, icons, symbols, paw prints, gems, diamonds, watermark or signature anywhere. No external shadow. Light source upper left.
